what_pays: Rank <=3 on the PRIVATE leaderboard (~207 of 309 test images) by UMUD score, subject to the FAIR/open-source/reproducibility check on the provisional top 3: CHF 1500 / 1000 / 500 (Rules s1.5; Overview Evaluation). Public cutoff 2026-09-03: #3 = 0.31898 (#1 0.29358, #4 0.35134). Ours: 1.15267, rank 121/198.
optimized_metric: UMUD score = (1/3)[MAE_PA/6deg + MAE_FL/12mm + MAE_MT/3mm] (+1e-6 MedAE, +1e-9 RMSE tie-breaks), lower is better; host scorer https://www.kaggle.com/code/paulritsche/umud-score mirrored in src/umud/metric.py

metric_validated_against_pays.correlation_evidence: The optimised metric IS the paying metric: the private LB is the same UMUD score on the other 67% of the test set (Foundational 7.a). Mirror exactness confirmed against the host notebook and by the FL constant sweep (MAE_FL(115)-MAE_FL(80)=16.46 mm, consistent with a 12 mm tolerance). Unmeasured residual: public->private drift, estimated 95% ~0.14 for one method from benchmark per-image SD 0.54 (assumption A4).

noise_floor.method: Deterministic scorer: resubmission variance is 0 (host scorer public; constant 2.41344 identical across teams). Sampling floor from benchmark per-image UMUD SD 0.54 (n=34, our pipeline): SE 0.053 at n=102 public, 0.038 at n=207 private; 95% public-vs-private drift for one method ~0.14. min_effect 0.10 = 2 SE for a delta between two DIFFERENT methods on public.
noise_floor.caveat: Estimated from the 35-image benchmark, whose error distribution is tighter than the test set; rung L1 (probed-median constant, predicted 1.0374 by metric separability) checks the constant-score model to ~0.01 and banks the true constant floor.
